name: film-product
prompt: A 20 second premium Apple-style product film for a Mac app called Flare, with an upbeat minimal electronic music bed and soft keyboard clicks. Shot 1: extreme macro of fingers pressing Command, Shift and Space on a silver laptop keyboard, a soft violet light sweeps across the keys. Shot 2: the laptop screen fills the frame, showing the violet silk wallpaper from the image reference; a dark translucent glass chat panel slides up in the lower right corner exactly like the reference videos, a question is typed and an answer streams in. Shot 3: slow pull back over a person's shoulder at a sunny cafe table, the panel still floating on the screen. Shot 4: a pastel isometric illustration of a tiny desk appears inside the glass panel. Shot 5: the glass panel slides away and the wallpaper glows. Smooth match cuts, shallow depth of field, clean and bright. No readable text overlays, no logos, no faces facing the camera.
